access.notes: Expected CSV columns: mixture_label, series, density_A, temperature_C, PV_Amagat. Values correspond to Table II of the source.

resources.name: Zero-pressure heat capacities of pure H2, N2, NH3

access.notes: Expected CSV columns: component, T_C, Cp_cal_mol_K. Data from Justi (1938) and Johnston & Davis (1934).

resources.name: Mixture metadata and conversion factors (Table I)

access.notes: Expected CSV columns: mixture_label, H2_mol_pct, N2_mol_pct, NH3_mol_pct, normal_volume_I_cm3, normal_volume_II_cm3, mole_mass_g, density_conversion_mole_per_cm3_per_Amagat, PV_energy_conversion_cal_per_mol_per_Amagat.
